scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run check:client-bundle && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: tsup src/server/index.ts src/server/start-server.ts --format esm --platform node --target node22 --out-dir dist/server --clean && tsx scripts/copy-server-assets.ts
scripts.build:company-server: npm run build && npm run build:company-mcp && npm run build:company-operations
scripts.build:electron: tsup src/electron/main.ts --format esm --platform node --target node22 --out-dir dist/electron --clean --external electron && tsup src/electron/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --target node22 --out-dir dist/electron --external electron
scripts.build:desktop-runtime: npm run build:native && npm run build:personal-archive && npm run build && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:mcp: tsup mcp-server/index.ts --format esm --platform node --target node22 --out-dir dist/mcp-server --clean
scripts.build:company-mcp: tsup company-mcp-server/index.ts --format esm --platform node --target node22 --out-dir dist/company-mcp-server --clean
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:component && npm run test:security && npm run test:native-read && npm run test:sandbox-archive && npm run test:personal-archive && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:company-mcp
scripts.build:company-operations: tsup scripts/company-backup.ts scripts/company-restore-check.ts --format esm --platform node --target node22 --out-dir dist/company-operations --clean
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:desktop-runtime && npm run package:mac:built
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc -p tsconfig.mcp.json && tsc -p tsconfig.company-mcp.json
scripts.test:native-read: npm run build:native && vitest run --config vitest.native.config.ts tests/native/native-read-helper.contract.test.ts
scripts.test:sandbox-archive: npm run build:sandbox-archive && vitest run --config vitest.native.config.ts tests/native/sandbox-archive.contract.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.archive.config.ts tests/archive/archive-recovery.test.ts tests/archive/archive-electron.test.ts
scripts.test:personal-archive: npm run build:personal-archive && vitest run --config vitest.native.config.ts tests/native/personal-archive.contract.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.archive.config.ts tests/archive/intake-archive.test.ts tests/archive/intake-service.test.ts tests/archive/intake-crash.test.ts
scripts.verify:fast: npm run check:architecture && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:company-mcp
scripts.verify:full: npm run check:architecture && npm run typecheck && npm run test:all && npm run build:desktop-runtime
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify:full && npm run test:e2e:fixtures && npm run package:mac:built && npm run test:electron && npm run build:company-mcp && npm run build:company-operations
